jobs.title: Business Lead - Pitstops
jobs.description: Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction . Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people , making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone. THE TEAM • ~160 people , around half in engineering, product and data • 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research • Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle • An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking , tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation The opportunity Pitstops are the local shops that power Relay. Every day, thousands of corner shops, newsagents and convenience stores take in parcels from our vans, hand them to couriers on bikes and in cars, and serve customers dropping off and picking up. They’re the reason we can deliver faster and cheaper than the big carriers. We’ve grown from a few hundred pitstops to thousands in two years. Next is the rest of the UK and the US. This role owns making that network work. That means the right pitstops, at a pay that works for them and for us. When one goes wrong, you see it the same day in parcels left behind and routes running late. You’ll build the systems that stop that happening, and fix it fast when it does. About the role Pitstop capacity vs required. Enough active, open pitstops with headroom in each zone. You will collaborate with a diverse team of engineers, and key stakeholders on security initiatives across the company. Above all, your focus is bringing Security expertise to the table in a collaborative, humble, and practical manner. jobs.description: About the job Deliver the power, cooling and capacity that enable Graphcore’s engineers to bring up and test AI systems. Based in Bristol, you’ll lead regional lab and data centre infrastructure delivery and own operational readiness. As Graphcore’s client-side representative, you’ll turn agreed engineering requirements into practical delivery plans and improvements. Your work will keep existing environments effective while creating capacity for testing and experimentation. You’ll identify constraints before they affect engineering work and improve reliability for high-density AI workloads. You’ll guide builds, expansions and upgrades from site assessment through design, installation, commissioning and handover. You’ll manage approved budgets, supplier commitments, schedules and delivery risks. As an individual contributor, you’ll use independent technical judgement to balance regional projects with day-to-day operations. Experience with liquid cooling and pressurised infrastructure is particularly relevant to this work. The team and culture You’ll agree regional priorities with Systems Engineering, hardware engineering, IT, facilities, health and safety, and finance. jobs.description: Role Summary Temporal is used by a lot of companies in a wide variety of contexts. Many use Temporal Cloud. Then you'll take the ones we commit to through launch and adoption. Open source Temporal is central to this. We’re investing heavily in OSS, from performance improvements to easier management to clearer guidance on compatibility and cost. When companies write their apps on Temporal, they’re making a huge bet on us, and that trust is sacred. A large part of this role is improving and shepherding how we keep making OSS better.
